rules.exact: Locale-neutral JavaScript toLowerCase; original punctuation and whitespace are retained. No Chinese character mapping.
rules.flexible: Apply locale-neutral toLowerCase; map each TSCharacters key to the stable endpoint of its first-candidate chain; discard Unicode White_Space, General_Category Punctuation, and U+FEFF. Symbols, emoji, zero-width format characters and unlisted characters remain.
rules.offsets: ranges returns non-overlapping half-open UTF-16 offsets into the original string, including ignored punctuation/whitespace between matched characters. Positions are constructed per ranges call, not retained by fold.
rules.limits: Character-equivalence search only. Not the full OpenCC converter, phrase disambiguation, regional vocabulary translation, semantic search, NFKC normalization, or full Unicode case folding.

modifications: Selected only first candidate from each upstream TSCharacters entry.
Omitted identity mappings and all alternative candidates; remaining dictionary compiled into a JavaScript lookup.
No TSCharactersExt or other phrase/variant dictionary is incorporated.
Search normalization never changes the displayed or downloadable original book text.
Collapse the one first-candidate chain (薴→苧→苎) to its stable endpoint so repeated normalization is idempotent; no alternative candidates are used.
